title: Quarterly Cadence Blueprint: Hosted API Release Windows & Model Catalog Health Signals
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a repeatable quarter-level cadence blueprint that ties Hosted API release windows to explicit model catalog health signals (latency, cost/unit, eval regressions, and drift). Deliverables: a decision checklist for model rotations, a public schedule of release lanes, a gating signal matrix, and a lightweight stakeholder sync ritual that reduces last-minute rollbacks.
objectives: Define 3 release lanes (Fast, Standard, Deeptest) with SLOs and capacity hedges
Create a model health signal matrix (latency percentile, cost/token, semantic regression score, p95 failure rate)
Establish a 4-week cadence template for canary windows, smoke evaluations, and rollback triggers
Reduce mid-quarter model rollback incidents by 50% versus last quarter
acceptance_criteria: A published cadence doc hosted in Confluence with lane definitions and SLO thresholds
A gating checklist that maps signal thresholds to go/no-go for canary promotion
A dashboard prototype in Console showing health signals per model tier
At least two partner teams (Search and Assist) sign off on the lane definitions and canary timing
milestones: 2025-01-22: Draft lane definitions and SLO targets
2025-01-29: Cross-functional review with Eng, SRE, DX and Security
2025-02-12: Prototype gating matrix and example canary window for 2 models
2025-02-26: Publish cadence blueprint and onboard pilot teams
2025-03-12: Run first scheduled canary under new cadence and capture learnings
risks: Incomplete signal coverage (some regressions won't be captured by chosen metrics)
Dashboards delayed due to telemetry work from runtime team
Teams may not adhere to lane windows leading to mixed rollouts
Capacity shortages during 'Fast' lane could force fallback to older models
dependencies: ENG-48210: model-metrics-exporter (telemetry ingestion for semantic regression)
